_rule: Guardrail G7: only items with status 'confirmed' may be built into the app. Everything else is link-out only until the owner confirms terms in writing. 'name' is the display name for link-out lists; 'kind': 'risk-instrument' marks structured risk instruments that need trained raters (the app never scores them or decides risk, G9).

PHQ-9.terms: No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute (Pfizer).

GAD-7.terms: No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute (Pfizer).

ICD-10-CM.terms: US government code set (CDC/CMS). NLM Clinical Tables API is free and provided as-is.

ICD-11.terms: Free; ICD-API requires registration and OAuth2 client credentials. Follow WHO licensing terms.

PCL-5.name: PTSD Checklist for DSM-5 (PCL-5)
PCL-5.terms: Believed free from the National Center for PTSD. Confirm before building in.

AUDIT.name: Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test (AUDIT)
AUDIT.terms: WHO instrument, believed free. Confirm before building in.

ISI.name: Insomnia Severity Index (ISI)
ISI.terms: Copyrighted; license likely required for commercial software.

PSWQ.name: Penn State Worry Questionnaire (PSWQ)
PSWQ.terms: Penn State Worry Questionnaire (Meyer et al., 1990). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

APA Severity Measures.name: APA online assessment and severity measures
APA Severity Measures.terms: APA online assessment measures, including the disorder-specific severity measures (panic, agoraphobia, generalized anxiety). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

C-SSRS.name: Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS)
C-SSRS.terms: Check permission terms for software use.

Stanley-Brown Safety Plan.name: Stanley-Brown Safety Plan form
Stanley-Brown Safety Plan.terms: Not built in. Electronic use of the Stanley-Brown form needs the authors' written permission, which has not been obtained. The app's own safety-plan worksheet (/tools/safety-plan) follows the app's own safety-plan handout (content/handouts/safety-plan.json): original headings, reasons to keep going first, company and help merged into one 'Connect with people' part, the safer-space part before 'Get help now', and six parts instead of the form's steps. It says it is not the Stanley-Brown form and only links to the authors' site. Clinical and legal review of this structure is still pending.

MDQ.name: Mood Disorder Questionnaire (MDQ)
MDQ.terms: Mood Disorder Questionnaire (Hirschfeld et al., 2000). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

ASRS.name: Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS)
ASRS.terms: WHO Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale (ASRS-5). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

MSI-BPD.name: McLean Screening Instrument for Borderline Personality Disorder (MSI-BPD)
MSI-BPD.terms: McLean Screening Instrument for Borderline Personality Disorder (Zanarini et al., 2003). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

SCOFF.name: SCOFF eating disorder screen
SCOFF.terms: SCOFF eating disorder screen (Morgan et al., 1999). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

EDE-Q.name: Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q)
EDE-Q.terms: Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (Fairburn and Beglin). Copyrighted; check permission for commercial software; link out only.

PQ-B.name: Prodromal Questionnaire-Brief (PQ-B)
PQ-B.terms: Prodromal Questionnaire-Brief (Loewy et al., 2011). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

SHAI.name: Short Health Anxiety Inventory (SHAI)
SHAI.terms: Short Health Anxiety Inventory (Salkovskis et al., 2002). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

PHQ-15.name: PHQ-15 somatic symptom scale
PHQ-15.terms: PHQ-15 somatic symptom scale (Kroenke et al., 2002), part of the PHQ family. Believed to share the PHQ-9 terms; the owner must confirm before it is built in. Link out only.

HRS.name: Hoarding Rating Scale-Interview (HRS)
HRS.terms: Hoarding Rating Scale-Interview (Tolin et al., 2010). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

BDDQ.name: Body Dysmorphic Disorder Questionnaire (BDDQ)
BDDQ.terms: Body Dysmorphic Disorder Questionnaire (Phillips). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

CUDIT-R.name: Cannabis Use Disorders Identification Test-Revised (CUDIT-R)
CUDIT-R.terms: Cannabis Use Disorders Identification Test-Revised (Adamson et al., 2010). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

DAST-10.name: Drug Abuse Screening Test (DAST-10)
DAST-10.terms: Drug Abuse Screening Test (Skinner, 1982). Copyrighted; check permission for commercial software; link out only.

COWS.name: Clinical Opiate Withdrawal Scale (COWS)
COWS.terms: Clinical Opiate Withdrawal Scale (Wesson and Ling, 2003), clinician-rated. Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

DSM-5-TR text.terms: APA copyright. Software license required; no input into AI tools without written permission.

Wiley PracticePlanners.terms: Wiley copyright; licensed commercially to EHRs.

NCCN-DT.name: NCCN Distress Thermometer and Problem List
NCCN-DT.terms: NCCN Distress Thermometer and Problem List (National Comprehensive Cancer Network). NCCN restricts reproduction; terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

DDS.name: Diabetes Distress Scale (DDS)
DDS.terms: Diabetes Distress Scale (Polonsky et al., 2005). Copyright and terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

EPDS.name: Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS)
EPDS.terms: Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (Cox, Holden and Sagovsky, 1987), copyright Royal College of Psychiatrists. Reported free to copy for clinical use with the full citation; use inside software needs the copyright holder's written permission, which has not been obtained. Link out only.

GDS-15.name: Geriatric Depression Scale, 15-item (GDS-15)
GDS-15.terms: Geriatric Depression Scale, including the 15-item short form (Yesavage et al., 1982; Sheikh and Yesavage). The authors' Stanford page describes it as public domain; that page could not be loaded for this check, so the owner must confirm the terms in writing before it is built in. Link out only.

Mini-Cog.name: Mini-Cog
Mini-Cog.terms: Mini-Cog (Borson et al., 2000), copyright S. Borson (mini-cog.com). Reported free for clinical use by individual clinicians; use in software, electronic records or commercial products needs a license from the copyright holder. Clinician-administered (clock drawing and recall). Link out only.

GAI.name: Geriatric Anxiety Inventory (GAI)
GAI.terms: Geriatric Anxiety Inventory (Pachana et al., 2007), copyright The University of Queensland. Reported to need a license from the copyright holder (gai.net.au), with fees for some uses. Link out only.

MoCA.name: Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA)
MoCA.terms: Montreal Cognitive Assessment (Nasreddine et al., 2005). Copyrighted; the publisher (mocacognition.com) requires training and certification to administer and a license for use in software or electronic records. Clinician-administered. Link out only.

PC-PTSD-5.name: Primary Care PTSD Screen (PC-PTSD-5)
PC-PTSD-5.terms: Primary Care PTSD Screen for DSM-5 (Prins et al., 2016). The VA National Center for PTSD page states it was developed by VA staff, is in the public domain and not copyrighted, and is intended for use by qualified health professionals (page read 2026-11-27). Not built in until the owner confirms. A screen only: a positive result needs clinician follow-up.

PEG.name: PEG pain intensity and interference scale
PEG.terms: PEG three-item pain intensity and interference scale (Krebs et al., 2009), published with its validation paper. Terms for software use not confirmed by the owner; link out only.

RHS-15.name: Refugee Health Screener-15 (RHS-15)
RHS-15.terms: Refugee Health Screener-15 (Hollifield et al.), developed by Pathways to Wellness (Lutheran Community Services Northwest). Reported free for screening use from the developers; terms for software use and for each translation not confirmed. Link out only.

AQ-10.name: Autism Spectrum Quotient, 10-item (AQ-10)
AQ-10.terms: Autism Spectrum Quotient, 10-item adult version (Allison, Auyeung and Baron-Cohen, 2012), Autism Research Centre, University of Cambridge. Reported free for research and clinical use; commercial or software use needs the Centre's permission. A prompt for referral to an adult autism assessment, not an assessment. Link out only.

ProQOL.name: Professional Quality of Life Scale (ProQOL)
ProQOL.terms: Professional Quality of Life Scale (B. H. Stamm; proqol.org). Reported free to copy and use when the authors are credited, items are not changed and it is not sold; terms for software use not confirmed. A clinician self-check that the app would never store. Link out only.

DRSP.name: Daily Record of Severity of Problems (DRSP)
DRSP.terms: Daily Record of Severity of Problems (Endicott, Nee and Harrison, 2006), copyright J. Endicott. Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

PHQ-2.name: PHQ-2
PHQ-2.terms: PHQ-2 (Kroenke, Spitzer and Williams, 2003), the first two PHQ-9 items. Distributed with the PHQ screeners, whose PHQ-9 and GAD-7 terms say no permission is required; the owner must confirm the same terms cover this short form before it is built in. Link out only.

GAD-2.name: GAD-2
GAD-2.terms: GAD-2 (Kroenke et al., 2007), the first two GAD-7 items. Distributed with the PHQ screeners, whose PHQ-9 and GAD-7 terms say no permission is required; the owner must confirm the same terms cover this short form before it is built in. Link out only.

PHQ-4.name: PHQ-4
PHQ-4.terms: PHQ-4 (Kroenke et al., 2009), the PHQ-2 and GAD-2 combined. Distributed with the PHQ screeners, whose PHQ-9 and GAD-7 terms say no permission is required; the owner must confirm the same terms cover this short form before it is built in. Link out only.

ASQ.name: Ask Suicide-Screening Questions (ASQ)
ASQ.terms: Ask Suicide-Screening Questions (NIMH). NIMH offers the ASQ toolkit as a free resource for medical settings and describes it as validated for youth and adults (page read 2026-11-27). A screen only: a positive screen needs a brief suicide safety assessment by a clinician. Not built in until the owner confirms; the app never scores or decides risk.

AUDIT-C.name: AUDIT-C
AUDIT-C.terms: AUDIT-C (Bush et al., 1998), the three consumption items of the WHO AUDIT. Believed free like the AUDIT; the owner must confirm. Substance-use content: answers would never be stored or transmitted (42 CFR Part 2). Link out only.

WHO-5.name: WHO-5 Well-Being Index
WHO-5.terms: WHO-5 Well-Being Index, published by WHO as WHO/UCN/MSD/MHE/2024.01 (page read 2026-11-27). The license that covers use inside software is not confirmed; link out only.

K6-K10.name: Kessler Psychological Distress Scales (K6 and K10)
K6-K10.terms: Kessler Psychological Distress Scales K6 and K10 (Kessler et al., 2002), Harvard Medical School National Comorbidity Survey. Reported free to use; terms for software use not confirmed. Link out only.

DASS-21.name: Depression Anxiety Stress Scales, 21-item (DASS-21)
DASS-21.terms: Depression Anxiety Stress Scales, 21-item version (Lovibond and Lovibond), UNSW Sydney. The authors describe the questionnaire as public domain while the manual is copyrighted; the owner has not confirmed terms for software use. Link out only.

CORE-10.name: CORE-10
CORE-10.terms: CORE-10 (Barkham et al., 2013), CORE System Trust. Reported free to use under the Trust's license when unchanged and not sold; terms for software use not confirmed. Link out only.

PROMIS.name: PROMIS measures
PROMIS.terms: PROMIS measures (Cella et al., 2010), distributed by HealthMeasures (Northwestern University). Reported free for clinicians and researchers; use in software or electronic systems needs terms or a license from HealthMeasures. Link out only.

WSAS.name: Work and Social Adjustment Scale (WSAS)
WSAS.terms: Work and Social Adjustment Scale (Mundt et al., 2002). Widely used without charge; copyright holder and terms for software use not confirmed. Link out only.

WHODAS 2.0.name: WHO Disability Assessment Schedule 2.0 (WHODAS 2.0)
WHODAS 2.0.terms: WHO Disability Assessment Schedule 2.0. WHO states that including WHODAS 2.0 in an electronic records or data capture system, or reproducing it in any way, needs a license through Licensing WHO Classifications (page read 2026-11-27). Not licensed; link out only.

NEQ.name: Negative Effects Questionnaire (NEQ)
NEQ.terms: Negative Effects Questionnaire (Rozental et al., 2016). Reported free to use from the authors; terms for software use not confirmed. Link out only.

ORS-SRS.name: Outcome Rating Scale and Session Rating Scale (ORS and SRS)
ORS-SRS.terms: Outcome Rating Scale and Session Rating Scale (Miller, Duncan and colleagues). Reported free for individual practitioners under a license from the authors; agency or software use needs a separate license. Link out only.

WAI-SR.name: Working Alliance Inventory, short revised (WAI-SR)
WAI-SR.terms: Working Alliance Inventory, short revised (Hatcher and Gillaspy, 2006). Reported free for clinical and research use from the WAI authors; terms for software use not confirmed. Link out only.

PGSI.name: Problem Gambling Severity Index (PGSI)
PGSI.terms: Problem Gambling Severity Index (Ferris and Wynne, 2001), Canadian Centre on Substance Use and Addiction. Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

FTND.name: Fagerström Test for Nicotine Dependence (FTND)
FTND.terms: Fagerström Test for Nicotine Dependence (Heatherton et al., 1991). Widely reproduced; copyright holder and terms for software use not confirmed. Substance-use content: answers would never be stored or transmitted. Link out only.

MGH-HPS.name: Massachusetts General Hospital Hairpulling Scale (MGH-HPS)
MGH-HPS.terms: Massachusetts General Hospital Hairpulling Scale (Keuthen et al., 1995). Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

Danger Assessment.name: Danger Assessment
Danger Assessment.terms: Danger Assessment (J. C. Campbell; dangerassessment.org). The form is reported free, but its weighted scoring and levels of danger are to be used only after the developer's training and certification. Trained clinicians only; the app never scores or decides risk. Link out only.

HCR-20.name: HCR-20 Version 3
HCR-20.terms: HCR-20 Version 3 (Douglas, Hart, Webster and Belfrage), a commercially published structured professional judgment guide. Purchase and training required; not licensed. Trained clinicians only; the app never rates or decides violence risk. Link out only.

MITI.name: Motivational Interviewing Treatment Integrity code (MITI 4)
MITI.terms: Motivational Interviewing Treatment Integrity code 4 (Moyers et al., 2016), CASAA, University of New Mexico. Reported free to download for training and research; a supervision aid for coding recorded sessions, not a client measure. Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

CTS-R.name: Revised Cognitive Therapy Scale (CTS-R)
CTS-R.terms: Revised Cognitive Therapy Scale (Blackburn, James and colleagues, 2001), Newcastle CBT Centre. A supervisor-rated competence scale for CBT sessions. Terms for software use not confirmed; link out only.

ASAM Criteria.name: The ASAM Criteria
ASAM Criteria.terms: The ASAM Criteria (American Society of Addiction Medicine), copyrighted. Use in software, including any level-of-care logic, needs a license from ASAM; not licensed. Link out only; the app never assigns a level of care.

LOCUS.name: Level of Care Utilization System (LOCUS)
LOCUS.terms: Level of Care Utilization System (American Association for Community Psychiatry), copyrighted. Electronic versions need a license from the association or its licensed vendors; not licensed. Link out only; the app never assigns a level of care.

AGS Beers Criteria.terms: AGS Beers Criteria for potentially inappropriate medication use in older adults (American Geriatrics Society, 2023 update), copyright AGS. The criteria tables are not reproduced or paraphrased anywhere in the app; pages link out to the published criteria. Reproduction or software use needs AGS permission.
